title: List 25–30 people in the seat you want
purpose: A named list of the people already doing, or hiring for, the job you want.
why: Recruiters search, and referrals convert many times better than cold applications. The network decides who sees your work first.
evidence: A list of 25–30 people working in or hiring for the roles you want.

tasks.title: Build the list: name, role, company, why them
tasks.done_when: 25–30 people listed, each with a one-line reason.

fields.label: Link to your list (doc or sheet)
